test.fill_query: SELECT throwIf(count() != 100000000 OR min(EventTime) < toDateTime('2013-04-01 00:00:00', 'UTC') OR max(EventTime) >= toDateTime('2013-10-01 00:00:00', 'UTC')) FROM hits_100m_single

SELECT throwIf((SELECT (count(), sum(cityHash64(toUInt32(t), toUInt64(w), d, c))) FROM ( SELECT toStartOfInterval(EventTime, INTERVAL 15 MINUTE, 'Asia/Kolkata') AS t, toStartOfWeek(EventTime, 1, 'America/New_York') AS w, toDayOfWeek(EventTime, 0, 'Europe/Berlin') AS d, count() AS c FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY t, w, d)) != (SELECT (count(), sum(cityHash64(t, w, d, c))) FROM ( SELECT intDiv(toUInt32(EventTime), 900) * 900 AS t, toUInt64(intDiv(toUInt32(EventTime) - 14400, 86400) - (intDiv(toUInt32(EventTime) - 14400, 86400) + 3) % 7) AS w, toUInt8((intDiv(toUInt32(EventTime) + 7200, 86400) + 3) % 7 + 1) AS d, count() AS c FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY t, w, d))) SETTINGS log_comment = 'query_shapes_hits.check'

SELECT throwIf((SELECT sum(cityHash64(formatDateTime(EventTime, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S', 'Europe/Berlin'))), sum(cityHash64(toString(ClientEventTime, 'Asia/Tokyo'))) FROM hits_100m_single) != (SELECT sum(cityHash64(toString(toDateTime(toUInt32(EventTime) + 7200, 'UTC')))), sum(cityHash64(formatDateTime(toDateTime(toUInt32(ClientEventTime) + 32400, 'UTC'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S'))) FROM hits_100m_single)) SETTINGS log_comment = 'query_shapes_hits.check'

SELECT throwIf((SELECT sum(dateDiff('second', ClientEventTime, EventTime, 'UTC')), sum(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(toStartOfInterval(toDateTime64(EventTime, 3, 'UTC') + toIntervalMillisecond(WatchID % 1000), INTERVAL 250 MILLISECOND))) FROM hits_100m_single) != (SELECT sum(toInt64(toUInt32(EventTime)) - toUInt32(ClientEventTime)), sum(toUInt32(EventTime) * 1000 + intDiv(WatchID % 1000, 250) * 250) FROM hits_100m_single)) SETTINGS log_comment = 'query_shapes_hits.check'

SELECT throwIf((SELECT countIf(EventTime > prev + 1800) FROM (SELECT EventTime, lagInFrame(EventTime, 1, EventTime) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prev FROM hits_100m_single)) != (SELECT sum(arrayCount((t, p) -> t > p + 1800, arrayPopFront(ts), arrayPopBack(ts))) FROM (SELECT arraySort(groupArray(EventTime)) AS ts FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY UserID))) SETTINGS log_comment = 'query_shapes_hits.check'

SELECT throwIf((SELECT count(), sum(cityHash64(SearchPhrase)) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SearchPhrase FROM hits_100m_single)) != (SELECT count(), sum(cityHash64(SearchPhrase)) FROM (SELECT SearchPhrase FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY SearchPhrase))) SETTINGS log_comment = 'query_shapes_hits.check'

SELECT throwIf((SELECT count(), sum(cityHash64(CounterID, EventDate, h)) FROM (SELECT CounterID, EventDate, intHash32(UserID) AS h FROM hits_100m_single LIMIT 1 BY CounterID, EventDate, h)) != (SELECT count(), sum(cityHash64(CounterID, EventDate, h)) FROM (SELECT CounterID, EventDate, intHash32(UserID) AS h FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY CounterID, EventDate, h))) SETTINGS log_comment = 'query_shapes_hits.check'

SELECT throwIf((SELECT count(), sum(cityHash64(UserID)) FROM (SELECT UserID FROM hits_100m_single LIMIT 2 BY UserID)) != (SELECT sum(least(c, 2)), sum(least(c, 2) * cityHash64(UserID)) FROM (SELECT UserID, count() AS c FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY UserID))) SETTINGS log_comment = 'query_shapes_hits.check'

SELECT throwIf(countIf(explain LIKE '%LimitBySortedStreamTransform%') = 0) FROM (EXPLAIN PIPELINE SELECT CounterID, EventDate, intHash32(UserID) AS h FROM hits_100m_single LIMIT 1 BY CounterID, EventDate, h)

SELECT throwIf(count() != 7 OR max(ProfileEvents['ExternalProcessingFilesTotal']) != 0 OR max(memory_usage) > 6000000000, 'a check is missing in query_log, spilled or used too much memory') FROM system.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND log_comment = 'query_shapes_hits.check' AND event_time_microseconds > (SELECT max(event_time_microseconds) FROM system.query_log WHERE log_comment = 'query_shapes_hits.start')
test.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(EventTime, INTERVAL 15 MINUTE, 'Asia/Kolkata') AS t, toStartOfWeek(EventTime, 1, 'America/New_York') AS w, toDayOfWeek(EventTime, 0, 'Europe/Berlin') AS d, count() AS c FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY t, w, d FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(cityHash64(formatDateTime(EventTime, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S', 'Europe/Berlin'))), sum(cityHash64(toString(ClientEventTime, 'Asia/Tokyo'))) FROM hits_100m_single FORMAT Null

SELECT sum(dateDiff('second', ClientEventTime, EventTime, 'UTC')), sum(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(toStartOfInterval(toDateTime64(EventTime, 3, 'UTC') + toIntervalMillisecond(WatchID % 1000), INTERVAL 250 MILLISECOND))) FROM hits_100m_single FORMAT Null

SELECT countIf(EventTime > prev + 1800) FROM (SELECT EventTime, lagInFrame(EventTime, 1, EventTime) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prev FROM hits_100m_single) FORMAT Null
SELECT DISTINCT SearchPhrase FROM hits_100m_single FORMAT Null
SELECT CounterID, EventDate, intHash32(UserID) AS h FROM hits_100m_single LIMIT 1 BY CounterID, EventDate, h FORMAT Null
SELECT UserID FROM hits_100m_single LIMIT 2 BY UserID FORMAT Null
